# Audio sources — CC0 1.0

soft-sweep.wav and soft-return.wav derive from “Broomstick whoosh 2 - Soft low OKM1” by Sadiquecat:
https://freesound.org/people/Sadiquecat/sounds/816261/
Source preview: https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/816/816261_5287430-hq.mp3

soft-key.wav derives from “mechanical key soft.wav” by bigmonmulgrew:
https://freesound.org/people/bigmonmulgrew/sounds/378083/
Source preview: https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/378/378083_6260145-hq.mp3

Both source pages declare Creative Commons 0. License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Edits: high/low-pass filtering, slight pitch reduction, trimming, level normalization and soft fades. Return sweep is reversed. No synthesized oscillators.
